html:
SMTO-CTR-0020 — SMTO couldn't verify the plan it prepared for a queued message

GUID: f6d0062e-ece6-47c4-87ff-9a5dab65344b
Slug: task-contract-preparation-snapshot-invalid
Domain: CTR · Subsystem: task-contract

What happened

  • When a message waits in the queue, SMTO writes its plan ahead of time. That saved plan didn't pass SMTO's checks, so SMTO didn't use it and took no action on that message.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Copy the text of the message that failed from the conversation so you have it ready. The plan prepared for it won't be used, so you'll need to send the request again.
  2. Send the same request as a new message, and let it start before you queue more messages behind it. SMTO writes and checks a new plan for the new message instead of reusing the one that failed.
  3. If it fails again, even for a short request sent when nothing else is running, open Technical details and select Copy error details. Repeated failures point to a problem with SMTO's saved data that the person managing it must look at.

What success looks like

  • The new message shows Task contract generated and starts working.

If it still fails

  • Send the copied error details to the person who manages SMTO. Don't delete the failed task before copying the details; they identify which saved plan failed the check.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A queued task's saved Task Contract preparation failed validation (allowlist, size, status, call accounting, revision digest, provenance or capability ceiling), exceeded its storage bound, or preparation failed internally, so the task failed closed.

What this means

  • Portable preparation validation rejects its envelope/digests/call accounting/capability ceiling, preparation storage exceeds bounds, or preparation fails before a client is available. This failure does not authorize execution for the rejected contract revision. Earlier revisions may already have effects; their original receipts remain authoritative. Diagnostic rendering makes no compiler or integrity-model call.

Why this can happen

  • Portable preparation validation rejects its envelope/digests/call accounting/capability ceiling, preparation storage exceeds bounds, or preparation fails before a client is available.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the failed snapshot invariant and preparation stage while preserving source and occurrence evidence.

How to fix it

  • Read the task's preparation record and failure reason: validate_snapshot and install_snapshot (src/agent_runtime/native/task_contract_snapshot.py) raise preparation_snapshot_invalid for envelope, 8 MiB size, status, transport-call accounting, revision digest or capability-ceiling mismatches; _save_preparation_in rejects state over MAX_STATE_BYTES; prepare_task_contract maps other preparation exceptions (including a missing client) to this text. Keep the request and error occurrence ID, resubmit so preparation runs again from the original source, and report repeated snapshot defects with the Server log.
  • Preserve the request and occurrence ID. Refresh task preparation from the original source; report persistent snapshot defects.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • Supported preparation reconstructs a coherent bounded snapshot from the intended source.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • This failure does not authorize execution for the rejected contract revision. Earlier revisions may already have effects; their original receipts remain authoritative. Diagnostic rendering makes no compiler or integrity-model call.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
